1879064085.name: Boast
1879064085.desc: Tales of your heroic acts draw cheers from the crowd.

1879064341.name: Track Treasure
1879064341.desc: Tracks treasure chests and valuable containers.

1879072533.name: Clinging Webs
1879072533.desc:
You spray your target with clinging, sticky webs, reducing their chance to hit you.<rgb=#00ff00>
 
 Applies Ensnared Effect. 
 Stacks 3 times. 
 </rgb>

1879109781.name: Litany of Defiance
1879109781.desc: Cries out to surrounding enemies, slowing their attacks.\nCashes out all Fortification effects on the Guardian, in order to double their mitigations for a short period of time, while also intercepting 10% of the fellowship's damage for each stack removed.

1879115285.name: Dagger Throw
1879115285.desc: This well thrown knife will root an in-bound target.

1879159189.name: DNT - Add Hint to target for Capture

1879193237.name: Face Your Fears and Perish (Positional Damage)

1879198357.name: Friend of the Wilds (Mountain-guardian)
1879198357.desc: Summons a Bog-guardian companion.\n\nThe Bog-guardian excels at dealing damage from range.

1879209877.name: Steed of the Minstrel
1879209877.desc: A mount carrying all the trappings that are used and needed by the minstrel.

1879232405.name: Precise Throw
1879232405.desc: A quick attack which deals Light Damage over time.

1879260053.name: Swift Bow
1879260053.desc: Loose two missiles in rapid succession.

conditionalEffects.description: Swift Bow has a chance to make Merciful Shot available.

1879271189.name: Nature's Fury
1879271189.desc: Whirls Frost damage around the enemy, with a chance to deal Lightning damage-over-time.

1879286677.name: Steadfast
1879286677.desc: This will free you from any Combat State.

1879335445.name: Steed of the Summer Sea
1879335445.desc: A horse from the Summer Festival.

1879391381.name: Call to Arms: Herald of War (Elvish Warrior)
1879391381.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of War into battle. This banner increases the damage dealt by those around it.

1879419541.name: Guide to Azanulbizar
1879419541.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Azanulbizar.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879450133.name: Red Salamander
1879450133.desc: Summons a salamander to keep you company and warm your hearth.

1879457557.name: Readied Blade
1879457557.desc:
Brandish your blade to increase your defences.
Grants immunity to Disarms.

<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879458197.name: Evergreen Sickle-fly
1879458197.desc: Summons a friendly sickle-fly to accompany you on your journeys.

1879466261.name: Volatile Salts
1879466261.desc: A phial of salts which will explode in a flash when broken.

1879488021.desc: Summons a Bog-guardian companion.\n\nThe Bog-guardian excels at dealing damage from range.

1879501333.name: Focused Strikes
1879501333.desc: Double-edged Strike and Flashing Blades become single-target skills, but deal more damage.

1879506581.name: Flame Sheath
1879506581.desc: Surround yourself in a shield of flame, increasing your fire damage and reflecting fire damage upon any attackers.

1879508757.name: Return to Sul Madásh
1879508757.desc: You're able to quickly return to Sul Madásh in Adagím in Mûr Ghala. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879519509.name: Fulgurite Rune-stone
1879519509.desc: Places a Rune-stone upon the ground which, after a few seconds, is struck by lightning, damaging and briefly stunning nearby foes. This skill can be placed at range.
